sources.title: FHWA 道路隧道土木手冊官方典藏
sources.titleEn: FHWA road-tunnel civil manual official archive
sources.scope: 官方典藏確認 2009 年、作者及涵蓋工法；本課原創計算不是手冊的專案實測資料。
sources.scopeEn: Official archive verifies 2009, authorship and method scope; original course calculations are not measured project data from the manual.

sources.title: CEDD 岩洞工程指南第二版
sources.titleEn: CEDD Guide to Cavern Engineering second edition
sources.scope: 2018 年第二版公開岩洞工程指引，涵蓋地質、岩栓、噴凝土、拱架、地下水與豎井；本課只重建原理。
sources.scopeEn: The 2018 second edition covers geology, bolts, shotcrete, ribs, groundwater and shafts; the course reconstructs principles only.

sources.title: FHWA 隧道檢查及 TOMIE 官方入口
sources.titleEn: FHWA tunnel inspection and TOMIE portal
sources.scope: 官方頁列明 2015 年 TOMIE 與資產檢查文件；是閱讀脈絡，不是本課施工允收值。
sources.scopeEn: Official portal lists the 2015 TOMIE and inspection documents; reading context, not construction acceptance values for these examples.

sources.title: EFNARC 噴凝土規格及試驗出版品
sources.scope: 官方索引確認 1996 規格、2011 面板彎曲及 2026 試板指引；不複製標準全文。
sources.scopeEn: Official index confirms the 1996 specification, 2011 panel bending and 2026 panel guidance; no standard text is reproduced.

sources.title: Sika 隧道材料與系統
sources.scope: 官方分類包含噴凝土、防水、注入及岩栓材料；只比較功能，不保證任何產品適用本課假想案例。
sources.scopeEn: Official classification includes shotcrete, waterproofing, injection and bolting materials; functional comparison only, without product suitability claims for hypothetical examples.

sources.title: Sika 隧道防水系統
sources.scope: 官方區分排水型、承壓型及分區膜系統，並列哥達與里德貝格案例；產品適用性須另查專案要求。
sources.scopeEn: Official distinction between drained, pressurized and compartment membrane systems, with Gotthard and Riedberg references; product suitability requires separate project assessment.

sources.title: 高應力岩體吸能岩栓原始研究
sources.titleEn: Original research on energy-absorbing bolts in high-stress rock
sources.publisher: International Journal of Rock Mechanics and Mining Sciences
sources.scope: 2010 年原始研究區分靜態、動態與現地驗證；官方索引已讀，直接 DOI 全文取回受阻。本課不用產品數值代替設計。
sources.scopeEn: The 2010 original research distinguishes static, dynamic and field evidence. Publisher-indexed content was retrieved; direct DOI full-text access was blocked. Product figures are not used as design values.

sources.title: 費馬恩隧道業主施工介紹
sources.scope: 業主介紹工廠、溝槽、管節及丹麥 2020、德國 2021 開工；課程數值均非其專案設計。
sources.scopeEn: Owner context on factory, trench, elements and Denmark 2020/Germany 2021 construction starts; course values are not project designs.

sources.title: Trelleborg Gina 沉管接頭密封
sources.scope: 製造商官方元件資料，支持密封功能比較；不借用產品壓縮曲線或額定值。
sources.scopeEn: Official manufacturer component information for functional comparison; no product compression curves or ratings are adopted.

sources.title: Trelleborg Omega 次級密封
sources.scope: 官方說明次級密封、壓差與多方向位移關係，並列深中通道比較案例。
sources.scopeEn: Official explanation of secondary sealing, differential pressure and multidirectional movement, with a Shenzhen-Zhongshan comparison case.

sources.title: Crossrail 帕丁頓車站設計
sources.scope: 專案團隊說明永久樓板支撐連續壁及逆打選擇理由；公開索引已核實，本課另設假想數值。
sources.scopeEn: Project-team explanation of permanent slabs bracing diaphragm walls and reasons for top-down construction; indexed page verified and course values independently assumed.

sources.title: MassDOT 大開挖隧道與橋梁
sources.titleEn: MassDOT Big Dig tunnels and bridges
sources.scope: 官方索引確認頂進、沉管與明挖等不同工法；直接頁面取回受限，不聲稱全文查閱。
sources.scopeEn: Official indexed page confirms jacking, immersed and cut-and-cover methods. Direct retrieval was restricted; no full-text review is claimed.

sources.title: PJA 頂管與微型隧道出版品
sources.scope: 協會官方索引涵蓋地調、管節、荷載、公差與良好實務；課程算例非指南專案數據。
sources.scopeEn: Association index covers investigation, pipes, loads, tolerances and good practice; course examples are not project data from the guides.

sources.title: PJA 中繼站分段推進原理
sources.scope: 官方第 22 頁說明中繼站前後管列分段移動與減少後座荷載；僅作機制研究，不作操作指令。
sources.scopeEn: Official page 22 explains staged movement of leading and trailing strings and reduced shaft loading; used for mechanisms rather than operating instructions.

sources.title: FHWA 非開挖工法與導向
sources.scope: 官方章節說明 HDD、頂管與微型隧道及導向干擾；歷史設備範圍不當作現行能力上限。
sources.scopeEn: Official chapter covers HDD, pipe jacking, microtunneling and guidance interference; historical equipment ranges are not treated as current capability limits.

sources.title: Network Rail 威靈頓箱涵頂進紀錄
sources.scope: 2021 年業主紀錄確認曲線箱涵、導向隧道及鐵路施工界面；本課尺寸與荷載均另設假想。
sources.scopeEn: The 2021 owner account confirms curved-box jacking, guide tunnels and rail interfaces; course dimensions and loads are separately assumed.

sources.title: Tideway Heathwall 2013 規劃文件
sources.scope: 第 K.4.24 節提出先沉井後托換的方案；這是 2013 規劃內容，不聲稱為最終竣工方法。
sources.scopeEn: Section K.4.24 proposes caisson sinking followed by underpinning; this is a 2013 proposal, not a claim about the final as-built method.

sources.title: Tideway Cremorne 豎井完工方法紀錄
sources.scope: 2020 年業主說明咬合樁加噴凝土襯砌；本課明確列為非沉井工法對照，不能因同屬 Tideway 就當沉井實例。
sources.scopeEn: The 2020 owner account describes secant piles and sprayed lining; explicitly a non-caisson comparison, not evidence that every Tideway shaft was sunk as a caisson.

limits: All numeric examples are original assumptions, not measured project data.
Public sources support the principles and publication context; no proprietary construction documents are claimed.
No listed security was reverified: security remains null.
